_comment: How the next release should be announced by the in-app update check.
Lives with the code, not in a deploy-time flag, so it is reviewed in the
same commit as the change it describes and cannot be forgotten at ship time.
optional     nothing about how the tool works has changed. Say so, and
tell people they can ignore it.
recommended  worth having. The default, and what an unknown value falls
important    fixes something that stops the tool working. Never use this
for anything less — it is the only word left that means it.
summary: one plain sentence, shown under the version number.
summary: Fixes a copy of ClickGraft that is missing a piece. If that ever happened, it asked macOS to install Apple's developer tools — a multi-gigabyte download, and the one thing ClickGraft exists to spare you — instead of telling you the copy was incomplete and to download it again. If your 1.8.2 works, nothing you can see has changed, and existing HP Click copies do not need to be made again.
